title: Value-Added Carry-Over Clause — Carrying Unused RideLink Trips into the Next Year
content:
A member who used Non-Emergency Medical Transportation value-added trips steadily through a year may carry some unused trips into the next year instead of losing them at year end.

**Clause.** The share of a closing year's unused value-added trips that may be carried follows the year's measured use of value-added trips: a use of at least the full-carry use of 12 lets all of them be carried; a use of at least the half-carry use of 6 but under 12 lets the half-carry share of 0.5 of them be carried, rounded down to a whole trip; and a lower use lets none be carried. The carried trips stay on the benefit for the next year, and the year's expiry entry carries the unused trips less the trips carried.

## Use bands

| Measured use of the year | Share of the unused trips that may be carried |
|---|---|
| 12 or more | All |
| 6 to under 12 | Half, rounded down to a whole trip |
| Under 6 | None |

## Cases

*Hypothetical closing years:*

| Unused trips | Measured use | May be carried | Expiry entry carries |
|---|---|---|---|
| 9 | 12 | 9 | 0 |
| 9 | 8 | 4 (half of 9 is 4.5, rounded down) | 5 |
| 9 | 5.9 | 0 | 9 |
| 6 | 6 | 3 | 3 |
